text:
ellen: starting the v2 rollout for /api/generate in eu-west. small canary (5%) over next 30m. heads up — we've enabled the new rate cap logic.
rahul: noted. are we leaving the v1 compat header open for mobile SDKs?
ellen: yes, x-rw-client-version pin remains; clients on older SDKS will still hit v1. this rollout only affects requests that explicitly opt-in with X-RW-API: v2.
priya: quick question — rate cap logic has a fallback path to v1 when tokens exceed bucket? i saw a PR but want to confirm behavior.
rahul: fallback only triggers when traffic shaping detects sustained 5xxs from v2 runtime OR when per-tenant QPS exceeds configured soft limit AND autoscaler can't catch up. then routing falls back to compatible v1 variant.
sre-ops: deploy-bot: can you paste the command we'll use to trigger emergency rollback if we see increased 5xx?
ellen: sure — use the deploy dashboard -> rollouts -> mark canary failed OR run: `curl -X POST https://deploy.internal/rollouts/3456/action -d '{"action":"fail_canary"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN'`
priya: thanks. can we add a deadman alarm on error-rate > 1.5% for 5m? don't want silent client regressions.
sre-ops: adding alarm now. threshold 1.5% 5m, linked to #incidents and oncall. also added a synthetic smoke that calls /api/generate with short prompt every 30s.
deploy-bot: rollback window scheduled at 2026-03-20T15:30:00Z if canary not promoted.
ellen: patch release notes: mention rate-cap fallback semantics, client header behavior, and that embeddings endpoint unchanged. I'll push to release-notes channel.
rahul: flagging that mobile sdk team has one client pinned to old header behavior until next release (android 1.4.2). we should not evict their traffic.
priya: noted — we'll keep soft pin for that tenant id range for 24h.
sre-ops: noticed slight tail latency bump on canary nodes (p95 +40ms) after enabling new kernel. CPU look ok, GPU kernels show small stall. watching.
ellen: if latency persists past 10m, we abort. also watch cost delta; if per-token cost > +8% on canary then roll back.
priya: adding a metric for per-token compute increase.
deploy-bot: canary at 5% for route /api/generate (v2) — start 3456789012. health checks passing (13/15).
rahul: received an alert from perf-test: KV cache miss rate jumped on v2 by 6%. could explain stalls.
sre-ops: digging into cache key normalization — possible header case-sensitivity mismatch. rolling a quick config to normalize X-RW-API header to lowercase on ingress for canary.
ellen: good catch. deploy that normalization to canary only. priya keep clients informed if we need extra pinning.
priya: will ping mobile and web leads.
ellen: if nothing noisy in 30m we promote to 25%. deploy-bot will post status.
deploy-bot: promotion scheduled at 3456789230 to 25% if canary healthy.
ellen: thanks everyone. thumbs up or :eyes: if you're watching.
rahul: :thumbsup:
priya: :eyes:
sre-ops: :thumbsup:
